BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.label: anti-mech squad
BeyondOurReach.KwazaariFavorDef.description: Four mechbreakers armed with maces, which carry EMP damage. A Kwazaari shuttle drops them off under your command for 12 hours. Another shuttle then comes to take them back. Each soldier who does not board it costs 7 scrip, even if that puts you in debt.
